AttachKeyPair.description_en: Attaches an Android Debug Bridge (ADB) key pair to one or more cloud phone instances
AttachKeyPair.description_zh: 调用AttachKeyPair绑定一个ADB密钥对到一台或多台云手机实例

AuthorizeAndroidInstance.description_zh: 为云手机实例分配用户或者取消已分配用户。目前一台云手机实例仅支持分配一个用户

BackupAndroidInstance.description_en: Creates a full backup of a Cloud Phone instance. The backup includes installed applications and properties
BackupAndroidInstance.description_zh: 对云手机实例进行整机备份，包括已安装的应用、属性等

BackupApp.description_en: Backs up specified applications on a cloud phone instance. The backup includes the application and its cache
BackupApp.description_zh: 对云手机实例的部分应用进行应用备份，包括应用、应用缓存等

BackupFile.description_en: Generates a backup file and uploads it to remote storage. You can use this operation for regular data backups. You can also back up files from one instance and restore them to multiple instances, a process similar to data replication or migration
BackupFile.description_zh: 生成备份文件并上传到远端存储。 使用场景：可以基于数据安全的角度进行定期备份，也可以备份一机文件，恢复到多机，实现类似复制迁移的效果

BatchGetAcpConnectionTicket.description_en: Retrieves connection tickets in batch. This operation generates connection tickets asynchronously. In most cases, the tickets are returned directly in the response of the first call. However, in some situations, the initial response will contain a `TaskId`. You must then poll this endpoint with the `TaskId` until the generation is complete and the tickets are returned
BatchGetAcpConnectionTicket.description_zh: 批量获取连接凭证。本接口会异步进行 Ticket 的生成，绝大多数可第一次直接从Response中直接拿到Ticket，部分情况需要根据Response中的TaskId再调用本接口进行轮询是否生成

CancelAgentTask.description_en: Cancels running agent tasks on a mobile node
CancelAgentTask.description_zh: 取消 Mobile 节点上正在运行的 Agent 任务

ChangeCloudPhoneNode.description_en: Modifies the configuration of a cloud phone matrix. Currently, only the instance type and the number of cloud phone instances (the instance count of the cloud phone matrix) can be changed
ChangeCloudPhoneNode.description_zh: 变更云手机矩阵的配置，目前仅支持变更实例规格和云手机实例开数（实例开数即云手机矩阵的实例数量）

CheckResourceStock.description_en: Checks the inventory status of cloud phone resources. Before creating an instance, you can use this operation to check whether the inventory in the target region is sufficient, and then proceed with creation after confirmation
CheckResourceStock.description_zh: 检查云手机资源库存状态。在实例创建前，可先通过该接口检测目标region库存是否足够，确认足够后再进行创建

CreateAndroidInstanceGroup.description_en: Creates pay-as-you-go or subscription cloud phone instance groups. An instance group can manage multiple instances. You can organize instances with the same functional purpose into the same instance group for unified management
CreateAndroidInstanceGroup.description_zh: 创建按量付费或包年包月的云手机实例组。一个实例组可以管理多个实例。可以将具有相同功能定位的实例编入同一个实例组，以便于统一管理

CreateApp.description_en: Creates an Android application. Before you can install an application, you must use this API operation to create it. The application is not downloaded when it is created. It is downloaded only during installation. Ensure that the cloud phone can access the download URL
CreateApp.description_zh: 创建 Android 应用。在进行应用安装前，必须先使用本接口进行应用创建。应用创建时不会进行应用下载，安装时才会进行下载操作，须确保云手机与下载URL的网络可达性

CreateCloudPhoneNode.description_en:
Creates a cloud phone matrix.

In the Wuying Cloud Phone system, a matrix (Cloud Phone Server) is a logical resource management unit that represents a physical server instance. The physical server can be divided into multiple independently running cloud phone instances that share the underlying compute, storage, and network resources of the matrix. Creating a matrix is equivalent to obtaining a physical server on which you can create cloud phone instances. The number of cloud phone instances varies based on the configuration
CreateCloudPhoneNode.description_zh:
创建云手机矩阵。

在无影云手机系统中，矩阵（Cloud Phone Server）是一个逻辑上的资源管理单元，代表一个物理服务器实例。该物理服务器可以被划分为多个独立运行的云手机实例，这些实例共享矩阵底层的计算、存储和网络资源。创建一个矩阵，即相当于获得一台物理服务器，您可以在其上创建相应的云手机实例（配置不同对应的云手机数量不同）

CreateCustomImage.description_en: Creates a custom image from a cloud phone instance. Then, you can use the image to create more cloud phones with the same configuration
CreateCustomImage.description_zh: 根据云手机实例创建自定义镜像。可以进一步通过自定义镜像创建更多相同配置的云手机

CreateEdgeMobileAgentPackage.description_en: Places an order to purchase an edge agent package
CreateEdgeMobileAgentPackage.description_zh: 下单购买边缘智能体套餐包

CreateKeyPair.description_en: You can connect to Cloud Phones using the Android Debug Bridge (ADB). ADB lets you manage devices and applications, and transfer files. These operations require high permissions. Because Cloud Phones do not have physical interfaces, you cannot use a USB connection to trigger an authorization dialog box on the device. Therefore, you must configure a key pair before you connect to a Cloud Phone with ADB over a network. This key pair ensures that the device trusts the client and that all operations are secure. You can call the CreateKeyPair operation to create an ADB key pair. The system stores the public key and returns the private key. The private key is in PEM-encoded PKCS#8 format and complies with ADB connection standards. You must securely store the private key
CreateKeyPair.description_zh: 用户可以通过ADB连接云手机，对云手机进行设备管理、应用管理、文件传输等操作。由于其操作权限较大且云手机没有物理接口，无法通过 USB 触发设备端的授权对话框。因此adb通过网络连接云手机，必须预先配置密钥对，让设备信任客户端，确保操作的安全。调用本接口CreateKeyPair可创建一对ADB密钥对。系统会为您保管密钥的公钥部分，并返回符合ADB连接规范的PEM编码的PKCS#8格式私钥。您需要自行妥善保管私钥部分

CreatePolicyGroup.description_en: Creates a policy that applies unified settings to cloud phones. These settings include features such as network redirection, watermarks, resolution, and the clipboard
CreatePolicyGroup.description_zh: 创建策略。策略用于对云手机进行统一的设置，例如网络重定向策略、水印、分辨率、剪贴板等功能设置

CreateScheduledTask.description_en: Creates a scheduled task for an agent

CreateScreenshot.description_en: This asynchronous API operation generates a screenshot of a cloud phone
CreateScreenshot.description_zh: 生成一张云手机的截屏图片，异步接口

CreateSystemPropertyTemplate.description_en: Creates a system property template. The key-value pairs defined in the template are sent to cloud phones and set as properties in their Android systems using the setprop command. APKs or related programs can then read these property values
CreateSystemPropertyTemplate.description_zh: 创建系统属性模板。属性模板中定义的属性键值对，将下发到云手机并通过setprop命令设置到云手机android系统中，APK或相关程序可读取这些属性值

DeleteAndroidInstanceGroup.description_en: Deletes an Android instance group. All instances in the group are also deleted. This operation cannot be undone. Proceed with caution
DeleteAndroidInstanceGroup.description_zh: 删除云手机实例组。 将同步删除实例组下的所有实例，删除后不可恢复，请谨慎操作

DeleteApps.description_en: Deletes an application. Before you delete an application, make sure that the application is not installed on any instances
DeleteApps.description_zh:
删除应用。
删除时需保证该应用未安装在任何实例组

DeleteBackupFile.description_en: Deletes a batch of backup files

DeleteKeyPairs.description_en: Deletes Android Debug Bridge (ADB) key pairs
DeleteKeyPairs.description_zh: 调用本接口删除云手机密钥对

DeletePolicyGroup.description_en: Deletes one or more policy groups

DeleteScheduledTask.description_en: Deletes a scheduled task of an agent

DescribeAndroidInstanceGroups.description_en: Queries the details of cloud phone instance groups
DescribeAndroidInstanceGroups.description_zh: 查询云手机实例组的详细信息

DescribeAndroidInstances.description_en: Queries the details of cloud phone instances
DescribeAndroidInstances.description_zh: 查询云手机实例的详情信息

DescribeApps.description_zh: 查询已创建的应用信息

DescribeBackupFiles.description_en: Queries a list of backup files

DescribeBuckets.description_en: Queries information about buckets. This operation returns only the buckets whose names start with `cloudphone-saved-bucket-`
DescribeBuckets.description_zh: 查询bucket信息，仅查询bucket名称以「cloudphone-saved-bucket-」打头的bucket list

DescribeCloudPhoneNodes.description_en:
Queries the details of a cloud phone matrix.

In the Wuying Cloud Phone system, a matrix (Cloud Phone Server) is a logical resource snap-in that represents a physical server instance. The physical server can be divided into multiple independently running cloud phone instances that share the underlying compute, storage, and network resources of the matrix. Creating a matrix is equivalent to obtaining a physical server on which you can create cloud phone instances. The number of cloud phone instances that can be created varies depending on the configuration
DescribeCloudPhoneNodes.description_zh:
查询云手机矩阵的详细信息。

在无影云手机系统中，矩阵（Cloud Phone Server）是一个逻辑上的资源管理单元，代表一个物理服务器实例。该物理服务器可以被划分为多个独立运行的云手机实例，这些实例共享矩阵底层的计算、存储和网络资源。创建一个矩阵，即相当于获得一台物理服务器，您可以在其上创建相应的云手机实例（配置不同对应可创建的云手机数量不同）

DescribeCreditDetail.description_zh: 查询积分的所有变动记录

DescribeEdgeMobileAgentPackages.description_en: Queries the details of edge agent packages
DescribeEdgeMobileAgentPackages.description_zh: 查询边缘智能体套餐包详细信息

DescribeImageList.description_en: Queries a list of available images

DescribeInvocations.description_en: Queries the execution results of a command run by calling the RunCommand operation
DescribeInvocations.description_zh: 查询RunCommand接口命令执行结果

DescribeKeyPairs.description_en: Queries one or more key pairs
DescribeKeyPairs.description_zh: 查询一个或多个密钥对

DescribeMetricLast.description_en: Queries the latest monitoring data for an instance or a matrix. You can query metrics such as CPU, memory, disk, and network
DescribeMetricLast.description_zh: 查询实例或矩阵的最新监控数据。支持 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络等监控数据的查询

DescribeMetricList.description_en: Queries monitoring data for specified metrics, such as network bandwidth
DescribeMetricList.description_zh: 查询指定监控项的监控数据，支持网络带宽等监控数据的查询

DescribeMetricTop.description_en: Queries the latest monitoring data for metrics such as instance network bandwidth and returns the results in a sorted list
DescribeMetricTop.description_zh: 查询排序后的最新监控数据，支持实例网络带宽等监控数据的查询

DescribeMobileAgentPackage.description_en: Queries the details of node packages
DescribeMobileAgentPackage.description_zh: 查询节点套餐详细信息

DescribeScheduledTaskExecutions.description_en: Queries the execution records of an agent scheduled task
DescribeScheduledTaskExecutions.description_zh: 查询智能体定时任务执行记录

DescribeScheduledTasks.description_en: Queries the list of agent scheduled tasks
DescribeScheduledTasks.description_zh: 查询智能体定时任务列表

DescribeSpec.description_en: Queries the available specifications for cloud phones. This information is required to create an instance. For the cloud phone matrix mode, this operation also returns the minimum and maximum number of instances allowed per matrix
DescribeSpec.description_zh: 查询云手机可用规格。 实例的创建需要指定规格参数，可通过该接口获取所有规格信息。对于矩阵创建的情况，可以通过该接口获取矩阵的最大和最小开数限制（单个矩阵创建实例数的限制）

DescribeTasks.description_en: Queries tasks created for a cloud phone instance. Many operations on cloud phones—such as creating, starting, or stopping them—are asynchronous. When you initiate an operation, the system returns a `Task ID` that you can use to track its progress and final result. You can call this API to retrieve a list of all tasks and their execution statuses
DescribeTasks.description_zh: 获取云手机实例当前任务列表。云手机很多（创建、开关机等）的操作都是异步进行，系统将产生一个任务ID供用户查询操作进度及结果。用户可通过调用该接口查询所有任务清单及执行情况

DetachKeyPair.description_en: Detaches an Android Debug Bridge (ADB) key pair from one or more cloud phone instances
DetachKeyPair.description_zh: 调用本接口解除ADB密钥对到一台或多台云手机实例的绑定关系

DisconnectAndroidInstance.description_en: Disconnects a connected instance or disassociates an instance that is associated with another user
DisconnectAndroidInstance.description_zh: 将处于连接中的实例断开连接，或将被其他用户绑定的实例进行解绑

DistributeImage.description_en: Distributes an image to one or more regions. This lets you use the image to create cloud phones in regions other than its source region
DistributeImage.description_zh: 分发镜像。如需要在更多的地域使用此镜像，可使用分发镜像功能，将镜像文件传输到各个地域，支撑各地域根据该镜像创建云手机的需求

DowngradeAndroidInstanceGroup.description_en: Downgrades an instance group. Currently, this operation allows you to only delete specific cloud phone instances from an instance group
DowngradeAndroidInstanceGroup.description_zh: 降级实例组。目前仅支持释放实例组中的指定实例

EndCoordination.description_en: Ends all coordination tasks for a cloud phone instance and invalidates the coordination code
EndCoordination.description_zh: 云手机所有者主动结束当前云手机实例的所有协同任务，协同码将同步失效

ExpandDataVolume.description_en: Expands the storage of a cloud phone matrix. You can expand shared storage for matrix-level files such as images, and instance storage. Expanding the storage incurs new fees, and the API response returns an order ID
ExpandDataVolume.description_zh: 扩容云手机矩阵存储。可以对共享机身存储（用于存储镜像等矩阵级文件）、独立机身存储进行扩容。存储空间扩容后将产生新的费用，接口调用的响应参数中包含了新费用的订单ID

ExpandPhoneDataVolume.description_en: Expands the phone storage for one or more matrix instances
ExpandPhoneDataVolume.description_zh: 该接口用于扩容矩阵实例的独立机身存储

FetchFile.description_en: Fetches files from a cloud phone to Object Storage Service (OSS)

GenerateCoordinationCode.description_en: By default, you can only use the BatchGetAcpConnectionTicket operation to get the ticket for a connection to a cloud phone, and a cloud phone supports only one connected user at a time. To allow multiple users to connect to a cloud phone at the same time, connect to the cloud phone with a convenience account, use this operation to generate a collaboration code by using the current account, and share this code with other convenience accounts to allow them to access the same cloud phone
GenerateCoordinationCode.description_zh: 云手机默认情况只能通过BatchGetAcpConnectionTicket接口获取连接Ticket，一个云手机只支持一个用户连接。如果需要多个用户连接同一个云手机。可为当前无影便捷账号连接中的云手机生成一个协同码，通过将协同码分享给其他便捷账号，则可实现其他账号连接到当前云手机的场景

GetInstanceProperties.description_en: Retrieves the properties of an instance. This operation runs the android getprop command to retrieve all properties of the cloud phone
GetInstanceProperties.description_zh: 获取实例属性信息。系统将通过android getprop命令获取所有云手机属性信息

GetNetworkBlacklist.description_en: Queries the network access blacklist for IP addresses and domain names
GetNetworkBlacklist.description_zh: 查询IP或域名网络访问黑名单信息

ImportKeyPair.description_en: Imports the public key of an Android Debug Bridge (ADB) key pair
ImportKeyPair.description_zh: 导入由ADB工具产生的ADB密钥对的公钥部分

InstallApp.description_en: Installs applications in batches on Cloud Phone instances
InstallApp.description_zh: 批量在无影云手机实例中安装应用

InstallMonitorAgent.description_en: Installs the monitoring plugin in a single step. An instance can generate monitoring data only after the plugin is installed
InstallMonitorAgent.description_zh: 一键安装监控插件，只有安装了监控插件，实例才会有监控数据

InstanceHealer.description_en: Diagnoses and recovers cloud phone matrix instances. This operation clears the system log files of an instance to prevent the instance from becoming unrecoverable due to a full disk
InstanceHealer.description_zh: 云手机矩阵实例诊断恢复，目前仅可以清理实例的系统日志文件，避免磁盘打满之后实例异常无法恢复

ListInstanceAdbAttributes.description_en: Queries the Android Debug Bridge (ADB) connection information for instances. This operation is available only to standard networks
ListInstanceAdbAttributes.description_zh: 查询实例ADB连接信息（仅限标准网络）

ListPolicyGroups.description_en: Queries the details of a policy

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries the tags that are associated with Cloud Phone instances
ListTagResources.description_zh: 查询云手机已添加的标签的列表

ModifyAndroidInstance.description_en: Modifies the information of an Android instance. Currently, this operation can be used to modify only the instance name and the upstream and downstream bandwidth limits
ModifyAndroidInstance.description_zh: 修改云手机实例信息，目前仅支持修改实例名称、上下行带宽限制

ModifyAndroidInstanceGroup.description_en: Modifies attributes of an instance group
ModifyAndroidInstanceGroup.description_zh: 修改云手机实例组的信息

ModifyCloudPhoneNode.description_en: Modifies a cloud phone matrix. Currently, you can only modify the name of a cloud phone matrix. Note: In the Cloud Phone system, a Matrix (Cloud Phone Server) is a logical resource management unit that represents a single physical server instance. This physical server can be partitioned into multiple, independently running cloud phone instances. These instances share the Matrix's underlying compute, storage, and network resources. Creating a Matrix is equivalent to leasing a dedicated physical server. On this server, you can then create your cloud phone instances. The number of instances you can create depends on their configuration
ModifyCloudPhoneNode.description_zh:
修改云手机矩阵信息。

在无影云手机系统中，矩阵（Cloud Phone Server）是一个逻辑上的资源管理单元，代表一个物理服务器实例。该物理服务器可以被划分为多个独立运行的云手机实例，这些实例共享矩阵底层的计算、存储和网络资源。创建一个矩阵，相当于获得一台物理服务器，您可以在其上创建相应的云手机实例（配置不同对应的云手机数量不同）

ModifyInstanceChargeType.description_en: Modifies the billing method. Currently, this operation only allows you to change the billing method from pay-as-you-go to subscription
ModifyInstanceChargeType.description_zh: 修改实例的付费方式。目前只支持按量付费转为包年包月

ModifyInstanceGroupSpec.description_en: Changes the specifications of instance groups. Currently, only specification upgrades are supported. Specification downgrades are not supported
ModifyInstanceGroupSpec.description_zh: 实例组规格变配，目前只支持规格升配，不支持降配

ModifyJVSInstance.description_en: Modifies the configuration of a JVS instance

ModifyKeyPairName.description_en: Modifies Android Debug Bridge (ADB) key pairs
ModifyKeyPairName.description_zh: 调用本接口修改ADB密钥对的名称

ModifyPolicyGroup.description_en: Modifies the information of a policy group

OperateApp.description_en: Operates apps in a cloud phone, such as opening, closing, and reopening apps
OperateApp.description_zh: 操作云手机内应用，支持打开、关闭、重启应用

PauseAgentTask.description_en: Pauses running agent tasks on Mobile nodes
PauseAgentTask.description_zh: 暂停Mobile 节点上正在运行的 Agent 任务

RebootAndroidInstancesInGroup.description_en: Reboots (shuts down and then starts) Cloud Phone instances
RebootAndroidInstancesInGroup.description_zh: 重启（先关机再开机）云手机实例

RecoverAndroidInstance.description_en: Restores a full instance backup to another cloud phone instance
RecoverAndroidInstance.description_zh: 将整机备份产生的云手机实例备份文件恢复到另一台云手机实例

RecoverApp.description_en: Recovers an application from a backup file to another cloud phone instance
RecoverApp.description_zh: 将应用备份产生的备份文件恢复到另一台云手机实例

RenewAndroidInstanceGroups.description_en: Renews subscription Cloud Phone instance groups. If a subscription instance group expires, the system automatically deletes the instance group and its instances after 15 days. You cannot recover deleted resources. Renew your instance groups promptly to prevent resource loss
RenewAndroidInstanceGroups.description_zh: 续费云手机实例组。预付费（包年包月）已到期 15天系统将自动删除实例组及其实例，且不可恢复，请及时进行续费操作

RenewCloudPhoneNodes.description_en: Renews the specified cloud phone matrices

ResetAndroidInstancesInGroup.description_en: Resets the instance by reinstalling the operating system using its original image. Note: The reset operation will fail if the image that was used to create the Cloud Phone has since been deleted
ResetAndroidInstancesInGroup.description_zh: 重置云手机实例。 重置是使用该云手机的镜像进行重装系统的过程，例如云手机创建时使用的镜像被删除将重置失败

ResumeAgentTask.description_en: Resumes an automated Agent task that is running on a Mobile node
ResumeAgentTask.description_zh: 继续Mobile 节点上正在运行的 Agent  自动化任务

RunAgentTask.description_en: Triggers an Agent on Mobile nodes to execute an AI automation task
RunAgentTask.description_zh: 触发 Mobile 节点上 Agent 执行 AI 自动化任务

RunCommand.description_en: Runs a command on one or more cloud phone instances
RunCommand.description_zh: 在云手机实例中执行命令

RunSyncCommand.description_en: Runs a synchronous command on one or more Cloud Phone instances and returns the execution result
RunSyncCommand.description_zh: 执行云手机命令，并尝试返回结果

SendFile.description_en: Pushes files from Object Storage Service (OSS) or a public download link to one or more cloud phones
SendFile.description_zh: 将OSS文件或者公网下载链接的文件推送到云手机

SendSystemPropertyTemplate.description_en: Sends a property template to cloud phone instances and, based on the template, sets properties in the Android system using the setprop command. An APK or a related program can read these property values. If you specify multiple template IDs, the property templates are randomly sent to the cloud phone instances
SendSystemPropertyTemplate.description_zh: 发送属性模板。将下发到云手机并通过setprop命令设置到云手机android系统中，APK或相关程序可读取这些属性值。如果指定了多个模板ID，则随机组合属性模板和云手机实例

SetAdbSecure.description_en: Sets the authentication status for cloud phone instances. If you enable Android Debug Bridge (ADB) authentication for cloud phone instances, the system will verify the validity of the ADB key pairs provided by end users when they connect to the instances over ADB. To ensure successful authentication and a proper connection, we recommend that you attach ADB key pairs to cloud phone instances. If you disable ADB authentication for cloud phone instances, the system will no longer verify the validity of any ADB key pairs. As a result, end users can connect to the cloud phone instances over ADB without authentication, provided the network connection is functioning properly
SetAdbSecure.description_zh:
设置实例的ADB鉴权状态。

如果设置ADB鉴权状态为开启，通过ADB去连接云手机实例时，云手机实例会校验ADB密钥对的合法性；此时建议您绑定ADB密钥对后，再通过ADB连接云手机实例。

如果设置ADB鉴权状态为关闭，通过ADB去连接云手机实例时，云手机实例不会校验ADB密钥对的合法性，即只要网络是通的，就能通过ADB连接上云手机实例

SetNetworkBlacklist.description_en: Adds or purges IP addresses and domain names from the network access blacklist
SetNetworkBlacklist.description_zh: 用于增加或清除IP地址和域名的网络访问黑名单

StartInstanceAdb.description_en: Enables the Android Debug Bridge (ADB) connection for an instance and creates an Internet mapping rule for its ADB port. This feature is available only for standard networks
StartInstanceAdb.description_zh: 开启实例ADB连接功能，为实例创建ADB端口公网映射规则（仅限标准网络）

StopInstanceAdb.description_en: Disables the ADB connection for an Android instance and deletes its ADB port forwarding rules. This operation applies only to standard networks
StopInstanceAdb.description_zh: 关闭实例ADB连接功能，删除实例ADB端口转发规则（仅限标准网络）

TagResources.description_en: Adds tags to one or more cloud phones

UninstallApp.description_en: Uninstalls applications from one or more Cloud Phone instances
UninstallApp.description_zh: 批量从无影云手机实例中卸载应用

UntagResources.description_en: Removes tags from cloud phones. If a tag is no longer associated with any cloud phone after it is removed, the tag is automatically deleted
UntagResources.description_zh: 为云手机移除标签。移除标签后，如果该标签没有被添加到任何云手机上，则标签会被自动删除

UpdateCustomImageName.description_en: Updates the name of a custom image

UpdateInstanceGroupImage.description_en: Updates the image of an instance group. This update affects all instances in the group
UpdateInstanceGroupImage.description_zh: 变更实例组镜像。会作用于该实例组下的所有实例

UpdateInstanceImage.description_en: Changes the image of an instance in a cloud phone matrix. You can change the image for an instance only when the instance is in the Running, Stopped, or Failed to change the image state. The GPU vendor of the target image must match the GPU vendor of the server where the instance runs. If you change the image across major versions, such as from Android 10 to Android 12, the system clears all data. This operation is equivalent to changing the image and then resetting the instance
UpdateInstanceImage.description_zh: 变更云手机矩阵实例镜像。仅支持对运行中、关机、镜像变更失败这三种状态的实例进行镜像变更。目标镜像的GPU厂商必须与当前实例所在的服务器GPU厂商匹配。如果是跨版本变更镜像，例如从Android 10升级到Android 12，则系统将强制清空所有数据（等同于变更镜像+重置）

UpgradeAndroidInstanceGroup.description_en: Upgrades an instance group. This operation only supports scaling out an instance group, which increases the number of instances
UpgradeAndroidInstanceGroup.description_zh: 升级实例组。目前仅支持增加实例组中的实例数量，即实例组扩容
